# Pact

> Pact lets a business get paid in USDT on Whitechain: hosted checkout, React and Expo checkout starters, payment links, subscriptions, refunds, exports and signed webhooks. Customers pay with an email sign-in, with no wallet, seed phrase or gas. These docs are written so a coding agent can integrate Pact for the merchant.

Network: Whitechain Sepolia testnet (chain ID 1874). API: https://api.pactagent.app with `Authorization: Bearer $PACT_SECRET_KEY`. Hosted checkout: https://pay.pactagent.app.

## Instructions for agents

- Start with the [Agent runbook](https://docs.pactagent.app/agents/runbook.md) and follow it in order.
- Keep `PACT_SECRET_KEY` and `PACT_WEBHOOK_SECRET` on the server. Never print, log, commit or bundle them.
- Decide prices on the server. Amounts are decimal USDT strings such as "12.50"; the minimum is "1.00".
- Fulfil direct payments only from a verified `payment.captured` webhook; product checkouts also emit `order.paid`. Verify `x-settle-signature` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body) before parsing, and dedupe on the event `id` and your own order identifier.
- Stop and ask the human for anything that needs their wallet: signing in, creating API keys, funding the gas tank, approvals and refunds.
- Use only the endpoints in [API for agents](https://docs.pactagent.app/agents/api.md). Don't invent others.
- The `@pactagent/*` npm packages may not be published yet. Check with `npm view` and fall back to the REST API.

## Integrate

- [Integrate with your agent](https://docs.pactagent.app/agents/overview.md): What the merchant does, what the agent does, and the prompt to hand off.
- [Agent runbook](https://docs.pactagent.app/agents/runbook.md): Step-by-step integration, webhook handling and verification checklist.
- [API for agents](https://docs.pactagent.app/agents/api.md): Every endpoint callable with a secret key, with request and response shapes.
- [How Pact works](https://docs.pactagent.app/integrate/how-pact-works.md): The pieces between the app, the customer and Whitechain.
- [Embedded checkout](https://docs.pactagent.app/integrate/embedded-checkout.md): React and Expo checkout components and the server proxy route.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.pactagent.app/integrate/webhooks.md): Payload, headers, event types and retries.
- [Agent payments (x402)](https://docs.pactagent.app/integrate/agent-payments.md): Charge AI agents per request in USDT through Pact's x402 facilitator.
- [Contracts](https://docs.pactagent.app/integrate/contracts.md): The contract set, functions and rules on Whitechain.

## Merchant

- [Introduction](https://docs.pactagent.app/index.md): What Pact does and why it settles onchain.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.pactagent.app/merchant/quickstart.md): Sign in, set up live payments, first product and checkout link.
- [Billing models](https://docs.pactagent.app/merchant/billing-models.md): One-time, subscriptions, invoices and tips.
- [Free trials](https://docs.pactagent.app/merchant/free-trials.md): Trial days on subscription plans.
- [Discounts](https://docs.pactagent.app/merchant/discounts.md): Discount codes and links.
- [Refunds](https://docs.pactagent.app/merchant/refunds.md): Full and partial refunds, verifiable onchain.
- [Subscriptions](https://docs.pactagent.app/merchant/subscriptions.md): Recurring billing under a signed price cap.
- [Exports](https://docs.pactagent.app/merchant/exports.md): Accounting CSV reconciled to the chain.
- [USDT on Whitechain](https://docs.pactagent.app/merchant/crypto.md): How customers pay without a wallet or gas.
- [Gas tank](https://docs.pactagent.app/merchant/gas-tank.md): How the merchant sponsors customer gas.
- [Drain protection](https://docs.pactagent.app/merchant/drain-protection.md): The limits that protect the gas tank.
